summary: Financial markets face mounting pressure as high borrowing costs, tightening credit conditions, and severe cracks in tech/AI funding weigh on sentiment globally. Meanwhile, surging credit spreads, plunging base metals like copper, and Asian market volatility signal rising macro stress.

picks.name: Bill Ackman
picks.text:
I think the Fed is about to make another mistake on December 9th. Financial conditions have tightened massively. For example, @SpaceX, an investment grade company, just raised secured debt financing at an 8.259% interest rate versus below 6% for its unsecured bond offering at the time of its IPO. 

The cost of equity capital has also increased materially with the recent substantial decline in the stock market. 

The Fed’s 2% inflation ambition is
picks.why: Bill Ackman warns that the Fed is making a policy mistake as financial conditions tighten sharply and corporate borrowing costs surge.
picks.watch: Treasury yields, broader credit markets, Fed policy outlook

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
High-grade tech companies are paying the most to borrow since the 2008 financial crisis, as the AI funding rush shows signs of cracking, per Bloomberg.

Yields on investment-grade tech bonds have climbed above 6%, the highest since 2009.
picks.why: Investment-grade tech bond yields climb above 6%, hitting levels not seen since 2008 as AI capital funding strains corporate balance sheets.
